No game studio, no team — just one AI and a single day
caption:
A single person built this full space exploration game in one day — no team, no studio, just AI.

The game plays like No Man's Sky, a title that took a whole studio years to finish. Now one person describes what they want, and an AI writes the entire game for them. A year ago, AI could barely handle a basic app.

What once cost millions and took hundreds of people might soon take one person and an afternoon.
